name: Working at 68: the Aktivrente
workings: Past the standard age (67) all year: 12 × 2,000 = 24,000 tax-free; taxable salary 26,000 (52%)
Contributions on all of it: pension 9.3% (no full pension drawn: still insured, more points); no unemployment insurance past the standard age; health 8.75% (with sick pay); care 2.4%
Deductible: 52% of the contributions: pension 2,418.00; health and care 2,808.00
